bootstrap_ci_95.measures: within-Berlin week-to-week noise only (12 post-treatment weekly gaps, resampled). Does NOT resolve the cross-city placebo uncertainty (p=0.167) -- both must be reported together.

secondary_finding.description: Treatment-window cohort week-4 retention vs. time-matched pre-treatment cohorts

projected_extrapolation.key_assumption: constant decay rate from observed weeks 0-4, extrapolated to 52 weeks; retention-window cohorts decay faster (0.623/4wk) than matched pre-treatment cohorts (0.754/4wk)
